messages:
oliver: quick heads-up — did a telemetry sweep on longctx workloads (seq=4096) with INT8 + BF16 mixed runtimes. noticed high slot entropy during warmup causing late KV paging. p95 token latency jumps ~18% for affected traces. attaching a couple of raw snippets below.

oliver: ```
telemetry: model=gptx-13B, quant=INT8, seq=4096, warmup_prefix=128, initial_kv_alloc=11.7GB, live_kv_peak=29.8GB, mem_after_compact=20.4GB
profile: p50=12ms p95=78ms p99=133ms (baseline fp16 p95=66ms)
observed: slot_fill_distribution skewed -> many tiny free gaps (~64B-512B) after compaction
```

maria_g: can you paste the kernel selection trace? curious whether we fell back from the tiled matmul to a generic kernel during the cramped pages. also which batching policy was used for those runs?

oliver: here's a short kernel trace from one repro run: ```
[step 40] kernel=matmul_tiled_small (fast path)
[step 41] kernel=matmul_tiled_small
[step 42] kernel=fallback_gemm_generic  <-- triggered when slot_fill>80% and paging started
[step 43+] repeated fallbacks until compaction finished
```

samir: hypothesis: fragmentation + tight coalesce window prevents reusing partially-filled slots, so we keep allocating new slots and trigger paging. INT8 compaction reduces memory (we measured ~32% savings on avg) but slightly perturbs alignment -> causes more tiny holes and triggers kernel fallback. accuracy trade: eval perplexity increased by ~1.2% vs bf16 baseline on our internal prompt suite. p99 latency also up ~8ms in those runs.

samir: data points: ```
- baseline (BF16, no compaction): KV 30.1GB, p95 66ms, ppl=12.3
- int8 + aggressive compaction: KV 20.6GB (-31.6%), p95 74ms (+12%), ppl=12.45 (+1.2%)
- int8 + relaxed coalesce: KV 22.3GB (-25.9%), p95 69ms (+4.5%), ppl=12.33 (+0.2%)
```

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rolled: slot-coalesce/relaxed-window -> prod-dedicated-1 at 1963004400. Canary status: passed basic health checks.

maria_g: actionable experiment plan: 1) increase coalesce window to 200 tokens for warmup epoch, 2) disable aggressive compaction during first 500 tokens of a longctx request, 3) pin kernel selection to prefer fp16 matmul for the first 2 steps to avoid fallback storm. We should gate with a quick perplexity eval after the canary.

oliver: I'll open a PR with the telemetry, the kernel traces and the coalesce/compaction toggles — linking GH#4310. Will push a canary with the relaxed settings and attach a perf dashboard.

samir: also add an eval hook that runs a 1000-example perplexity check post-canary. fail the rollout if relative ppl delta > 0.8% or if p95 latency regresses >10ms. cc @oncall

oncall: oncall: acknowledged, will monitor the canary. setting alert: "kv-slot-entropy-int8-regress" threshold ppl>0.8% or p95+10ms.

oliver: thanks — will report back with canary numbers in ~45m.
